answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 57829 Country: Bangladesh Title: How many Kaffara have to be paid? Question: If a person says that he is taking an oath that he will never ever tell lies in his life and after that he tells lie 3 times, then how many times he has to pay kaffarah for his breaking oath, one time or three times ? He did not take oath again after his breaking oath for the first time. Answer ID: 57829 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 353/346/H=05/1436) When he took an oath that he won’t tell a lie then he must have fulfilled it. However, after telling lie first time, he will be required to pay kaffarah and the oath came to an end. و تنحل اليمين إذا وجد الشرط مره (الدر مع الرد 5/605، زكريا) However, it is necessary to avoid telling a lie in any case. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
